# Lottery Parakeet

> Worldwide lottery results, top jackpots, winning numbers, and expert reviews of online lottery sites.

Lottery Parakeet helps players check official-style draw results, compare upcoming jackpots, and read guides about playing lottery games online and in the US.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://lottery.comparakeet.com/): Jackpots, latest numbers, US and international lottery links, and articles.
- [Top Jackpots](https://lottery.comparakeet.com/top-jackpots): Largest upcoming prizes worldwide.
- [USA Lottery](https://lottery.comparakeet.com/usa-lottery): US state lottery hub.
- [International Lottery Results](https://lottery.comparakeet.com/international-results): Lotteries by country.
- [Best Online Lottery Sites](https://lottery.comparakeet.com/best-online-lottery-sites): Comparison and reviews of lottery ticket services.

## Content

Editorial pages and guides are loaded from the WordPress CMS at lottery.comparakeet.com. Live draw numbers and jackpot amounts come from a lottery results API and update throughout the day.
